name: NetStat
author: Nyanako
short: Live connection metrics and a watchdog heartbeat.
description: `[p]netstat` shows gateway latency, the Lavalink voice WS ping and frame stats, and the UDP send rate in an embed that refreshes every 5 seconds. With a webhook set, the cog POSTs the same metrics every 60 seconds so an external watchdog (for example n8n) can alert when they go bad or stop arriving.
install_msg: Load with `[p]load netstat`. Run `[p]netstat` while Audio plays; set a heartbeat target with `[p]netstatset webhook <url>`.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores no user data. It stores one owner-set webhook URL and sends bot-level metrics (latency, player counts, frame and UDP counters) to it.
